maya: quick follow-up from the postmortemonvert learnings into tests + owners. notes: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-21-kv-cache

samir: propose 3 lanes: regression (prompt sets + golden tokens), load (steady + spike), chaos drills (node/network/kv-evict). each lane needs owner + 90-day maintenance plan.

leah: i'll own regression. plan: extract top-15 customer prompts, mark 5 for CI-minimal, store golden token sequences and a semantic fallback. will add a small delta checker.

enrique: i'll take load. nightly steady-state + separate spike job. use k6, terraform canary pool, grafana panels. alert if p95 or error-rate >15% vs baseline.

samir: chaos: monthly small randomized drills + quarterly full. include pre-checks, traffic ramp, KV eviction sim, and post-drill validation (run regression minimal).

maya: action items + due dates: leah -> prompts + CI config (2026-04-04, ticket #4931); enrique -> nightly load + make target + alert (2026-04-10, ticket #4932); samir -> chaos runbook + ops-bot automation (2026-04-06, ticket #4933); maya -> add rollout gate to block model switches until CI-minimal passes (2026-04-03, ticket #4934).

leah: opening PR for minimal prompts and delta-checker today. will tag reviewers.
enrique: pushed proto terraform module and stub k6 script to ci/load-scenarios. will post dashboard link when panels are live.
samir: chaos runbook draft added to the postmortem ticket; will iterate with SRE/devops. includes rollback commands and emergency contact list.

devops-bot: Scheduled job: monthly-chaos-drill at 2026-04-15T03:00Z. Results will be posted to #incidents.

maya: please add owner handles to the postmortem ticket, set milestones, and we'll do short weekly check-ins until these land. thanks!
